|Submission Name|✅ Auto-generated|User can override|
|Account Name|✅ Required|Search from Salesforce|
|Group|✅ Optional|Search from Salesforce|
|Type|✅ Required|Default "New Business"|
|Submission Record Type|✅ Required|"Insurance" for new business|
|Product Line|⏳ Phase 2|Set during quoting|
|Broker Contact|✅ Optional|Search from Salesforce|
|Brokerage (Lookup)|✅ Optional|Search from Salesforce|
|Incumbent Brokerage|✅ Optional|Free text or lookup|
|Parent Brokerage|❌ Out of Scope|Low priority|
|First Quote Date|⏳ Phase 2|Set when quote created|
|1st Binder Follow-up Date|⏳ Phase 2|Set during binding|
|Underwriting Specialist|⏳ Phase 2|Set via routing|
|Underwriter|⏳ Phase 2|Set via routing|
|Submission Notes|✅ Optional|Free text field|
|Probability (%)|❌ Out of Scope|Not used in Phase 1|
|Primary Reason Won|⏳ Phase 2|Set at close|
|Reason Lost|⏳ Phase 2|Set at close|

|*#*|*Acceptance Criteria*|
|1|User can access "New Submission" button from the Submission Dashboard|
|2|System displays a form with the following Required Fields: Submission Name (auto-generated or user-entered), Account Name (search/lookup from Salesforce), Type (New Business), Need By Date, Effective Date (optional in Phase 1, default to Need By Date + 30 days)|
|3|System displays the following Optional Fields: Group (search/lookup if part of a group), Broker Contact (search from Salesforce), Brokerage (lookup from Salesforce), Incumbent Brokerage, Parent Brokerage|
|4|System displays the following Read-only/System Fields: Submission Owner (defaults to current user), Created By, Created Date|
|5|User can search for existing Account Name using type-ahead search that queries Salesforce API|
|6|System auto-generates Submission Name in format: {Account Name}-{Type}-{YYMMDD} (e.g., "Academy of Art University-New Business-260101")|
|7|User can click "Save" to create the submission record or "Save & New" to create another|
|8|After save, system creates submission record in Workbench DB and syncs to Salesforce via API|
|9|User is redirected to the Submission Drill-Down page (SCR-03) upon successful save|
